text: The FY2025 Drainage Development Works is a S$150 million initiative by Singapore's Ministry of Sustainability and the Environment and PUB, Singapore’s National Water Agency, aimed at reducing flash-flood risks due to intense monsoon rainfall and sea-level interactions. It includes six new projects starting in 2025 and 19 ongoing upgrades, all part of a comprehensive 'Source–Pathway–Receptor' stormwater management framework. The initiative is designed to alleviate flood hotspots and integrate with long-term coastal protection strategies.
